purpose: Preserve bounded multi-root snapshot UI work after loss of the execution workspace. This JSON is an inert recovery artifact; it does not activate runtime changes.

provenance.source: Executed edit history and retained session summaries, checked against exact remotely fetched base files.
provenance.reconstruction: Complete new files are reconstructed from executed edit history. Whitespace and formatting are not guaranteed byte-identical to the former workspace.
provenance.tested_boundary: The former workspace passed 62 tests across seven batch/UI/localization suites, including 17 new batch cases, before the uncertain-save repair. That result does not validate this reconstructed artifact.
provenance.final_repair: The uncertain-save service branch and real store race test were written before disconnection. The localization values, hint substitution, and compact Arabic history widget regression are preserved as proposed final repairs that were not applied or tested before the environment failed.
provenance.tests_not_run: No tests, analysis, formatting, or builds were run against this recovery bundle.
provenance.activation: Apply only in a restored checkout after strict base/context checks; format, analyze, and run the required focused gates before activating or claiming acceptance.
